text:
alex: Hey team — noticed a cluster of fncall validation failures popped up at 09:12 UTC and some downstream customers saw 'internal fallback' instead of clear errors. Dashboard shows a jump in `fncall.validation.fail` but we don't have consistent `route_id` or `validation.code` in the events.

priya: saw that too. raw ingest has entries like `validator=v2 strict` and payloads dumped to logs, but the console UI just says "Tool response rejected" with no reason. PMs are getting noisy.

jon: sample log: ```json
{"tool":"price_lookup","out":"[\"9.99\"]","meta":{"user_id":"u_12345"}}
```
Our schema wants `{"price": {"amount": number, "currency": "USD"}}` so the array got coerced and rejected. We currently tag event as `fncall.validation.fail` and that's it.

emma: is this the new schema gate rollout? We ramped strictness to 10% last week. I thought we added a `validation.context` blob to help triage.

alex: the rollout flipped two things: (1) new strict validator (v2) and (2) a router change that collapses headers for fallthroughs. Together they strip `X-Route-Id` on fallback. result = un-attributable rejects.

kai: for telemetry we should send: `fncall.validation.error` (counter), `fncall.validation.error.code` (enum), `fncall.validation.payload_snippet` (redacted string), `route_id` and `model_variant`. Keep fields flat for our ingestion.

priya: +1 for flat fields. also suggest `validation.severity` (info/warn/error) so alerts can be tuned.

jon: billing problem: many of these rejects are still counted as full requests. finance flagged a potential customer credit if we can't show reject reason. two approaches discussed in the past: mark sampled validation traffic as non-billable, or do a post-hoc `billing.credit` event for samples.

emma: for a rollout UX I'd prefer a soft-preview mode in Console where PMs can opt-in a route to "Preview strict" which shows a stream of rejected payloads (PII redacted) and suggested fixes. no billing impact while in preview.

alex: implementation options: A) route preview traffic to a separate plan id (non-billable) via routing rule (low infra friction), B) keep on-plan but emit `billing.credit` later (accounting reconciliation complexity). Which is cleaner?

kai: A is simpler operationally. We already support variant routing by header; adding a preview-plan id should be quick. We need guardrails so preview doesn't accidentally get used in prod traffic.

priya: console feature: per-route "Schema Preview" toggle with sampling slider, plus an audit table showing last 100 sampled rejects. require owner approval to enable for >5% traffic. redact user identifiers automatically.

jon: telemetry retention — for sampled payloads we should only keep a short window (7 days) for privacy. full rejection metrics can go to long-term aggregates.

emma: alerts: create an alert recipe for sudden rise in `fncall.validation.error` (e.g., +200% in 10m) that includes top `validation.code` and a deep-link to the preview table. Also add a sticky banner on Route page when rejects > threshold.

alex: infra patch list: 1) router: preserve `X-Route-Id` across fallback and tag preview plan id (owner: kai), 2) validator: emit `validation.code` and `validation.hint` in the reject event (owner: jon), 3) console: add Schema Preview toggle + sampled table + retention controls (owner: priya), 4) billing: prototype preview plan routing vs credit events (owner: finance - needs meeting).

kai: i'll open a small PR to change header behavior and add integration test. canary to 5% first. deploy-bot shows last router deploy `deploy-2026-03-10-78`.

deploy-bot: Revert window remaining 4h 5m for deploy-2026-03-10-78.

priya: UX note: in the preview table we should surface an anonymized example and a one-line suggested fix (from `validation.hint`) so PMs can quickly approve a fix rollout. also include a button to create a bug in Jira.

jon: splitting `validation.code` into a small enum helps grouping: e.g., `MISSING_FIELD`, `TYPE_MISMATCH`, `ARRAY_INSTEAD_OF_OBJECT`, `UNKNOWN_FIELD`. keep a freeform message too.

emma: privacy redaction rules: remove `user_id`, `email`, `phone`, and mask numeric ids. we'll use the same redact library as logs to ensure consistency. documented in the Console privacy section.

alex: timeline: blocker for strict-validate global flip. propose we pause full rollout until router + telemetry + console preview ready. target: router patch in 48h, validator emit in 24h, console prototype in a week.

kai: started a branch now. testing header change locally.

priya: i'll mock the console preview UI and link it to a sample feed endpoint. will show retention options (7d default).

jon: i'll add the ENUM and sample hints to the validator and ship a migration note for consumers.

emma: scheduling a 30m sync with finance + ops to decide billing approach. sending calendar now.

alex: thanks. please add short notes to the rollout checklist and mark the global strict flip as blocked until these land. :lock:

jon: +1

priya: +1

kai: +1
